title: A critical Prowler cloud-posture finding auto-promotes to a risk register entry
preconditions: Cloud posture scan ingestion pipeline running against risk-management-service
steps: Trigger a Prowler scan result ingestion containing a CRITICAL severity finding
Wait for the module-risk-triage worker to process the event
expectedResult: A new Risk entry is created in risk-register with source='cloud-posture', inherited severity mapped correctly, and a link back to the originating finding.

title: Closing a treatment plan recalculates residual risk score
steps: Open a risk with inherent score 20 and an approved treatment plan in progress
Mark the treatment plan as completed
expectedResult: Residual risk score is recalculated using the post-treatment likelihood/impact values and displayed on the risk detail page.

title: Moving a risk's phase to mitigation auto-advances treatment.status from not_started to in_progress
description: RiskRegisterService.movePhase() has a PHASE_STATUS_FORWARD map (mitigation->in_progress, monitoring->completed, closure->completed) that fires only when the current treatment.status is still 'not_started', keeping treatment status in sync with RMF phase without requiring a separate manual update.
steps: Fetch the risk again via GET /risks/:riskId
expectedResult: risk.phase is 'mitigation' and risk.treatment.status has been auto-set to 'in_progress' without a separate treatment update call.

title: Regressing a risk's phase back to identification resets treatment progress to 0 and status to not_started
description: movePhase()'s REGRESSION_PHASES logic (identification, assessment) resets an in-flight treatment when the risk is moved backward, preventing a stale 'in_progress' or 'completed' treatment status from surviving a re-opened risk.
preconditions: Risk in phase 'mitigation' with treatment.status='in_progress' and treatment.progress=60
steps: POST /risks/:riskId/phase with targetPhase='assessment' and a regression note
Fetch the risk and inspect treatment.status and treatment.progress
expectedResult: treatment.status is reset to 'not_started' and treatment.progress is reset to 0.

title: Milestone progress reaching 100% auto-completes the treatment plan and sets completedDate
description: updateMilestoneProgress() checks risk.treatment.progress after each milestone update: >=100 -> status='completed' + completedDate=now; 0<progress<100 -> status='in_progress'; progress=0 while status='completed' -> reverts to 'not_started'.
preconditions: Risk has a treatment plan with one open milestone at 80% progress
steps: PUT /risks/:riskId/treatment/progress with the milestone's progress set to 100
expectedResult: risk.treatment.status becomes 'completed' and risk.treatment.completedDate is populated, computed from the milestone update rather than a separate treatment PUT.

title: Only a user named in acceptance.approvers can process the acceptance decision
description: processAcceptanceDecision() checks existingRisk.acceptance.approvers.some(a => a.userId === user.userId) after confirming a pending request exists, and returns 403 'You are not authorized to approve this request' for any authenticated user with risk.approve permission who isn't on the named approver list — the authority-matrix enforcement point.
preconditions: UserB holds the risk.approve permission but is not in approverIds
expectedResult: Request is rejected with 403 'You are not authorized to approve this request' even though UserB has the risk.approve permission — permission alone does not satisfy the named-approver authority check.

title: Uploading evidence attaches its ID to the risk's evidenceIds array and is retrievable from the risk detail response
description: EvidenceService.uploadEvidence() writes the file to S3, creates a RiskEvidence record, then calls addEvidenceToRisk() to push the new evidence's ObjectId onto risk.evidenceIds — linking evidence to the risk it substantiates.
preconditions: An existing risk with no evidence
steps: Upload a document-type evidence file scoped to the risk
expectedResult: The new evidence's ObjectId appears in risk.evidenceIds, and GET evidence-by-risk returns the uploaded item with freshnessConfig defaults (freshDays=30, agingDays=60, staleDays=90) applied.

title: Promotion is blocked with 409 when the source finding is no longer an active material failure
description: ModuleRiskService.promote() re-validates moduleRisk.sourceState==='active', currentSignal.status==='FAIL', and policyDecision.material===true immediately before insert — even if the candidate was pending when the triage list was fetched — closing a race where the underlying finding resolved between page load and the analyst's promote click.
preconditions: A pending module risk whose sourceState has since transitioned to 'resolved' (e.g. the Prowler check passed on rescan)
steps: POST /organizations/:orgId/module-risks/:id/promote with the stale candidate's id and matching projectId
expectedResult: Request fails with 409 'Cannot promote: the source finding is no longer an active material failure' — no risk is created in the register.

title: Updating a risk's framework/UCL control mappings enqueues a compliance-sync snapshot
description: updateFrameworkMappings() and updateUclMappings() both call RiskComplianceBridgeService.notifyMappingSnapshot() with the current set of requirementDocIds/uclIds after every mapping write, keeping the compliance-frameworks module's coverage view in sync with risk-driven control mappings.
preconditions: A risk mapped to zero controls
steps: PUT /risks/:riskId/mappings/frameworks with one requirement carrying a requirementDocId
Inspect the compliance-frameworks side for a corresponding mapping snapshot event
expectedResult: A mapping-snapshot notification is dispatched referencing the new requirementDocId, without requiring a manual compliance-map recalculation trigger.
